projects.title: Kriti Herbals
projects.summary: Turning a herbal brand story into a performance-led campaign.
projects.outcome: 10× revenue from the reel campaign · 5× from a static creative
projects.description: A complete reel campaign for a D2C herbal brand, from the visual concept through scripting, editing, and regional-language adaptations. The campaign became a top-performing creative on the Meta ad account. A companion static ad also delivered a strong result.

projects.title: Ilaiyaraaja Live
projects.summary: A complete visual world for a live concert in Bengaluru.
projects.description: Led design execution across event identity, stage visuals, social campaign, promotional reels, and print collateral, coordinating a cross-functional creative team through a live-event production timeline.

projects.title: Dehab India
projects.summary: A cohesive creative direction across content and packaging.
projects.outcome: A hero creative delivered a 15× sales uplift
projects.description: End-to-end creative production for a D2C brand, spanning social media content, packaging design, and print collateral. A hero creative set the visual direction for the brand’s ongoing content strategy.

projects.title: Manoranganz Events
projects.summary: A flexible event design system made for many kinds of gathering.
projects.description: An ongoing design partnership supporting corporate gatherings, marathons, reunions, team outings, and sports events across India. Deliverables include banners, standees, stage backdrops, brochures, arches, entry points, and event identity systems.
